stories.title: Clubhouse Leader
stories.detail: Jason Young in front with 33 pts - the kind of lead Souths grind out, not pretty, very effective

stories.title: Someone Call Security
stories.detail: 2 big ones on holes 17 & 18 - the handicapper has questions

stories.title: The Charge
stories.detail: Turned it on - 15 coming home vs 9 out

stories.title: The Great Escape
stories.detail: Michael McCormack in with 26 pts - the great escape, blue balls handed to somebody else

stories.title: In the Hunt
stories.detail: 2nd - 5 off the pace

stories.title: The Bolter
stories.detail: Ken Child up 16 spots - like the Crows: quiet all day, lethal late

stories.title: Welcome to WWCC
stories.detail: Welcome aboard, Des Taylor - the club is glad to host Duntryleague GC today. Enjoy every hole.

stories.title: Big-Dog Territory
stories.detail: 3-pointers on 3 of the par 5s - bombing them and cashing in

stories.title: Rock Solid
stories.detail: Zero wipes and 8 two-pointers - boring in the best way

stories.title: Reachable Feeling
stories.detail: 2 of the par 5s gave up 3-pointers - length is a weapon

stories.title: Short-Hole Sniper
stories.detail: 2 threes on the par 3s - dialled in with the irons

stories.title: Under the Radar
stories.detail: 3 3-pointers+ through the round - not flashy, just effective

stories.title: One-Point Parade
stories.detail: 3 in a row on holes 2, 3 & 4 - sticking to the 1-point script

stories.title: Variety Pack
stories.detail: Wipes, 1s, 2s, 3s - something for everyone on this card

stories.title: The Metronome
stories.detail: 6 holes in a row at 2 points or better - tick, tick, tick

stories.title: Finding a Rhythm
stories.detail: 4 twos on the bounce on holes 18-3

stories.title: Building Something
stories.detail: 3 twos on holes 1, 2 & 3 - the round is taking shape

stories.title: Steady Eddie
stories.detail: 7 two-pointers, not a wipe in sight - metronomic golf

stories.title: Settling In
stories.detail: 4 twos in a row on holes 17-2 - starting to look comfortable

stories.title: Bounce-Back Merchant
stories.detail: Answered every wipe with points next hole - never let one become two

stories.title: Going Rogue
stories.detail: Back-to-back on holes 17 & 18 - the field is on notice

stories.title: Textbook Stuff
stories.detail: 6 twos in a row on holes 10-15 - not a bad thing, actually

stories.title: The Bounce Back
stories.detail: Wipe then a 3-pointer on holes 15 & 16

stories.title: The Course Wins Again
stories.detail: 3 straight on holes 12, 13 & 14 - the handicap card stays in the bag
